rust_summary: level events, game events, explosions and lightning through a `LevelRef` (`native_level_level_event`, `native_level_game_event`, `native_level_explode`, `native_level_strike_lightning`).
doc_summary: events, explosions and lightning in a level through a `LevelRef`, as vanilla's `Level`: `level.level_event(host, id, pos, data)` (`Level.levelEvent` with no excluded player), `game_event(host, event, at)` (`Level.gameEvent`, heard by sculk sensors, wardens and allays), `explode(host, center, radius, fire, interaction)` (`Level.explode` with no source; `NativeExplosionInteraction::None`, `Block` or `Tnt`) and `strike_lightning(host, at, visual_only)` (asked of `lightning_strike` with the cause `mod`). All four return false for a stale handle, a client and a parked level (they act on the level in place). Besides: `level_event` refuses a state-carrying event (2001, 2014, 3008) whose `data` isn't a state; `game_event` an unknown event or a position outside the world; `explode` an unloaded chunk or a radius outside 0 < r <= 32; `strike_lightning` an unloaded chunk, a position outside the world or a canceled strike. Bundles need "hooks": @API:level_events@.
